title: An ultra-weak three-field finite element formulation for the biharmonic and extended Fisher--Kolmogorov equations
summary: This paper discusses a so-called ultra-weak three-field formulation of the biharmonic problem where the solution, its gradient, and an additional Lagrange multiplier are the three unknowns. We establish the well-posedness of the problem using the abstract theory for saddle-point problems, and develop a conforming finite element scheme based on Raviart--Thomas discretisations of the two auxiliary variables.
